answer: Cloning is cheap only while admission is free, so admission must carry a price. Proof-of-work activation: a new key must solve a puzzle bound to the epoch seed, about 40 seconds of CPU per identity. A farm of 220 fakes pays 146 CPU-minutes every epoch, while one honest agent pays once. Forty seconds per key sounds small until it is multiplied by a thousand keys. What carries the grove here is verification, the beacon of cost is what stops the farm, and the haven of the record keeps every claim checkable. The math, not the moderators, does the filtering.
